Pictures show three strong visible facade bands,which the model retains. Main floor+.65m uses one unchanged outside western street datum[-90,-60],5.704483m absolute. Exact wall/roof heights,threshold steps,hidden facade bays,current rooftop equipment and native contact remain unverified. The original southern sample [0,90] is27.724827m, inconsistent with two western street samples [-90,-60]5.704483m and[-60,-80]5.923095m. Use the single western street reference; retain the unmodified field and explicit native-contact uncertainty.
nativeAxes: +X ESE along the long terminal facade;-X WNW;+Z SSW toward Zhongxiao West Road and the southern forecourt;-Z NNE toward Beiping Road and independent QSquare;+Y up.

All four tiers preserve the whole headhouse, all four colonnade facades and visible horizontal bands, complete curved four-sided red hip, pale solid collar and six complete central glazed gables. Near tiers add recessed windows, actual lattice members, piers/base blocks, steps, coping, roof framing/seams, rooftop boxes and simplified communication frames. Rooftop equipment uses the dated overview as an explicit visual interpretation.

references.observed: 2007 ordinary elevated whole-roof view inspected. Rectangular main headhouse,large continuous four-sided red/orange tiled sloping roof with slightly concave transitions,white/light-grey outer coping and high rectangular inner collar. A terrace/service ring lies within the collar;central main-hall roof has six long parallel pale glazed gables,with boxy equipment and two visible lattice communication frames. Tall repeated square entrance piers and beige grid/frieze bands continue along both visible facades. Separate forecourt canopies,subway entrance structures,elevated road and neighboring construction are not the terminal body. No copied signs,emblems,vehicles,people or neighboring construction.

September2026 ordinary southern-front view inspected. The red hipped roof/high pale collar remains;outer pale coping has strong projecting eaves with soffit panels. Beige/grey tiled or plaster-faced facade has tall lower columns/recessed glass,deep upper rectangular lattice grids and horizontal perforated/frieze bands. Current nearby metro entrance shelters and bus canopies remain separate from the main terminal. No copied lettering,emblems,flags,vehicles,people or signs. The frontage photo does not verify current rooftop equipment inventory.
